beer.beer_description: nspired by the thigh-burners, loose rock and views that’ll throw you off your line at Bike Glendhu. Monsoon Hoon is a beer built for fast laps, loose corners, and the inevitable post-ride yarn. A clean and lean malt base lets the Freestyle hops Manilita, Peacharine and Sourthern Cross do the dirty work. Red grapefruit, white peach and lemon up front, finished with a snappy bitterness that keeps it tight. Point it down. Crack it open.

items.badge_description: Hoppy International Beer Day! Beer is the common thread that connects us worldwide, bringing people together in a unique way. And beer has played a significant role in shaping countless of our most cherished memories. If there is one thing we've learned along the way: Beer is best when shared with others. Join us in recognizing remarkable breweries worldwide by unlocking the fresh 2026 International Beer Day Badge. And don't forget to follow us on Instagram @untappd so that you never miss the next badge drop!

Hoppy IPA Day! Did you know that, since our inception in 2010, our hoppy lil’ community has checked in over 400 million IPAs? That’s a seriously staggering amount of hops!⁠ Today, we celebrate the hoppiest of days with the hoppiest of badges—the 2026 IPA Day Badge.
